id: ESTCMP3: estimator comparison on more seeds (literature comparisons only) - IMU-SME vs tuned momentum observer, enhanced MOB + KF (Sun et al. 2026 principle), centroidal + IMU (Fedsi et al. 2026 principle)
registered: 2026-10-27, before the ESTCMP3 runs. Same replay, thresholds (25 N for all, from ESTCMP2 calibration seed 1110) and EMO measurement noise (ESTCMP2 calibration) as ESTCMP2; nothing re-tuned
data: final controller DB, pelvis IMU, OBS2 logs; 50 N 0.2 s pushes along x and y; seeds 1140-1149 (20 runs)
metrics per run: detection latency (first 2-tick crossing of 25 N by the fast component after 3.0 s); RMS horizontal error in 3.0-3.5 s restricted to real double support with landings excluded (as the post hoc ESTCMP2 analysis)

decisions.LATENCY: IMU-SME mean latency lower than each comparison, one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p < 0.05 (paired by run)
decisions.ACCURACY: IMU-SME mean double-support RMS lower than each comparison, one-sided Wilcoxon p < 0.05
